explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that matches this theorem. It is the induction step of Tsen–Lang theory: if forms over k have nontrivial zeros once the number of variables exceeds degree^r (the C_r property), then forms over RatFunc k have nontrivial zeros once it exceeds degree^(r+1) (the C_{r+1} property). I searched Mathlib for Tsen, C_i / quasi-algebraically closed fields and Chevalley–Warning. The only related result is `FieldTheory/ChevalleyWarning.lean`, which deals with polynomials over finite fields and has nothing to do with rational function fields or the C_r property. The proof itself relies on the library's own lemmas (`clear_denominators`, `interchange`, `exists_nonzero_common_zero_of_single_form_bound`) and not on any single Mathlib result.
